summary.text: Stephanie Pitcher is a Democratic state senator from Utah who has represented District 14 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, she previously served in the Utah House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: Stephanie Pitcher lives in Sugarhouse, Utah.

According to Ballotpedia, she earned a bachelor's degree in English creative writing from Utah State University, a master's in public administration from the University of Utah, and a J.D. from the University of Utah S.J. Quinney College of Law.
Her career includes work as an attorney, including as a deputy district attorney and leader of the county's Mental Health Court, and she founded the Utah Women's Coalition.
Pitcher served in the Utah House of Representatives, District 40, from 2019 to 2023, and was elected to the Utah State Senate in 2022.
She was assigned to the Government Operations and Political Subdivisions, Government Operations, and Natural Resources, Agriculture, and Environment committees in 2023-2024.
She defeated Tayler Khater in the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
